page_title: Configure license plate, driver, and company information
page_content:
[TOC]

### Prerequisites
- A usable remote control and normal display screen

### Operation steps

1. Enter the main menu function interface, operate the remote control direction keys and ENTER key, enter Settings-Basic Settings-User, set the license plate number, driver name, company name
